Coram:
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE VIKAS MAHAJAN  ORDER % 19.12.2025 1.
Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application stands disposed of.

3. The present petition has been filed on behalf of the petitioners under Section 528 BNSS, 2023 seeking following relief:
"Quash the F.I.R. bearing No.0327/2024, dated 28.10.2024, P.S. Preet Vihar, East District, New Delhi, U/S 498A/406/34 of IPC along with charge sheet and all consequential proceedings arising therefrom in connection with the present F.I.R."
4.
Issue notice.
5. Ms. Kiran Bairwa, learned APP for State accepts notice.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 22/12/2025 at 21:19:07 6.
On petitioner taking steps, issue notice to respondent no.2 returnable on 23.04.2026.
VIKAS MAHAJAN, J DECEMBER 19, 2025/
